Description: Stores customer request data for the rules engine.

Stores event trigger definitions associated with Dataverse tables, including monitored attribute updates, conditions, actions, and plugin registration execution details such as create/update execution, pre/post stage, and sync/async mode.

Links an event trigger to a group of conditions and the actions that should execute. If all of the rule's conditions pass, its actions are executed; otherwise evaluation moves on to the next rule group within the trigger.
Stores individual condition rules (field name, operand, value, and value label) that are evaluated against an incoming or existing attribute to determine whether an associated event trigger applies.
Stores the actions associated with a rule group. When all conditions in the rule group pass, these actions are executed.
